title: Check the velocity before reading the orbit
summary: A reference merger gives consistent relative speeds from its reconstructed trajectory and the catalog’s collision-speed field.

sections.heading: A single sample with clear units
body: Read the main and secondary position and peculiar velocity triples from row 5. Compute the nearest periodic separation, then convert positions from ckpc/h to proper kpc with a/h. Subtract the two velocity vectors in km/s and take the norm.

At snapshot 70, the stored sample after first passage gives 95.4061 proper kpc and 3,689.6624 km/s. The absolute difference from the recorded V_coll for this row is about 0.00015 km/s. This is a consistency check on a specific event and release.

checks.title: Input and numerical verifier
checks.result: The atlas exporter pins the HDF5 digest and checks the corrected Mhistory_vel dimensions 2,083 × 70 × 6. The reference replay checks row 5.

next: Use the documented snapshot IDs and independently traced hosts before treating an ensemble of merger rows as independent events.
